report.explanation: Operator hypothesis of a faulty deployment causing checkout errors is contradicted by current telemetry: all sampled checkout traces return 200 across order, inventory, payment, and postgres spans, and gateway metrics show /v1/checkout 200 with zero 502s. The only deployment record is baseline order 1.0.0 with no previous version, which cannot establish deployment-caused errors. No bounded cause is supported; handing off.
missing_evidence: Error/failure telemetry (non-200 checkout responses, error logs) to confirm checkout errors actually occur
Logs evidence (excluded from context) to characterize any checkout failures
Deployment history with a prior version and timing relative to error onset
Latency/error metrics per downstream dependency to test alternative causes
